newsitem.title: USA: Aon unit, CNA Financial to end venture.
newsitem.headline: Aon unit, CNA Financial to end venture.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp and Scarborough & Co, a subsidiary of Aon Corp, mutually agreed to terminate their insurance venture known as COMBANC-PRO, effective February 1, the companies said on Thursday.
COMBANC-PRO was formed in 1993 for the placement of various insurance coverages, including bond and directors and officers liability for preferred community financial institutions.

Both companies will independently pursue the community financial institutions market. Scarborough said it entered into a new agreement with Gulf Insurance Group, with quotes from Gulf on new business available through Scarborough as of February 1.
